headline: HOU @ MIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 3.73 at MIN 4.36, with a projected total of 8.10. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIN: HOU moved -1.49 runs while MIN moved -0.16, changing the projected margin by -1.34 runs. The projected total fell -1.65, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +10.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Joe Ryan has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Bell, Ryan Jeffers, Kody Clemens, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Zach Cole, Cam Smith because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
